**Finding: Compliant (preferred position).**

The agreement contains an affirmative anti-exclusivity statement in the Services clause (p0001): *"Nothing herein is intended nor shall be construed as creating an exclusive arrangement between Customer and Kubient. This Agreement will not restrict Customer offering Inventory via other agents or otherwise selling Inventory to any third parties."*

This exceeds a mere absence of exclusivity — it is an express reservation of our freedom to use other agents and sell Inventory to third parties. I confirmed there is no exclusivity embedded elsewhere: no requirements-purchase, sole-supplier, non-compete or competitor-restriction language appears anywhere in the document. The remaining uses of "exclusive" are benign or favourable to us (a non-exclusive licence grant to Customer, exclusive jurisdiction in New York, each party's ownership of its own marks, and the no-third-party-beneficiary provision).

No redline proposed.
